name: procedure_callers
description: Return the provider's resolved direct callers for one procedure identified by symbol or address. Results reflect completed static analysis and may omit unresolved indirect references. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in Evidence limitations. Select detail summary for selected facts and a context digest; native-observation and native-context views retain complete source access.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
